comparison.objective: Reconfigure planter rows and center them on a hitch, versus commission an adjustable shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Large implement repositioning, spacing, and centering versus small recessed-tool alignment, fine rotary adjustment, and locking.
comparison.success_condition: Four rows at 30 inches centered on the hitch versus two safe repeatable dynamic stops with retained setting.
comparison.reason: Static agricultural layout adjustment does not test impact-energy tuning. No specs expose placement tolerances or failure rules.
